content:
elaine: Quick heads-up — opening PR: adds concise tenant-isolation example + SDK snippet + migration notes for Dedicated provisioning. aim: short snippet for handbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (WIP).

matt: Thanks — can you include the autoscale policy limit example? last time customers hit weird eviction on burst. snippet for scalePolicy.cooldown would help.

elaine: Good call. Adding cooldown and a sample reservedPool setting. yaml below — feedback welcome:

```yaml
tenant:
  id: acme-inc
  reserved_pool: small-ssd
  scale_policy:
    max_replicas: 8
    cooldown_seconds: 300
```

gil: Nit: max_replicas should be consistent with SLA tiers in the table (silver=5, gold=10). maybe use 5 for silver sample? Also add note about preemption annotations.

elaine: Switching to silver example. Will add preemption: 'eviction_policy: best_effort'. Also adding SDK snippet (python) — wanting to show how to set label 'tenant:acme' during provisioning.

olivia: Can you keep the SDK snippet tiny? one-liner that shows `client.dedicated.create_provisioning(... )` and link to full sample.

elaine: Planned SDK snippet:

```py
client.dedicated.create_provisioning(tenant_id='acme', reserved_pool='small-ssd', scale_policy={'max_replicas':5})
```

ben: Two asks: (1) add sentence about SLA tradeoffs when using reserved pools vs shared (latency vs cost). (2) add redirect for broken link in handbook (old link /docs/dedicated/onboarding -> /docs/dedicated/tenant-onboard).

elaine: Will add — also noticed an old anchor in the table of contents that breaks anchors in the migration guide. I'll submit patch to fix anchors.

matt: Small CI note: docs build will fail if codeblock has tabs. use 2-space indent. I'll run the lint after you push.

elaine: pushed changes to PR branch (force-push to tidy). Requesting reviews from @matt and @olivia. PR ready for quick pass.

docs-bot: PR 4123 opened by elaine — status: open, checks pending. build/docs-lint queued.

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll review after lunch. If it's short we can ship today.

gil: One more technical detail: include note about KV cache invalidation when switching model variants mid-rollout — otherwise cache mismatch may increase latency. Maybe one sentence under 'rollout considerations'.

elaine: Added sentence and a tiny diagram link to the runtime page. Merging once checks pass and two approvals. Thanks!
